root_cause: production_multi_cluster_dispatch interpreted an absent broker provider_states entry as UNAVAILABLE even though ClusterTabLeaseManager.providerState defaults absent entries to HEALTHY; after broker restart snapshots contained provider_states={} so every route was rejected before live readiness classification
fix: dispatcher now uses the broker contract default HEALTHY for absent explicit state; generateConsoleProviderImage still performs live provider readiness classification before prompt dispatch and persists AUTH_REQUIRED/CHECKPOINT/DEGRADED/HEALTHY back to broker state
